title: Red Allen's competitiveness versus JCH's own attitude
summary: Red Allen thought nobody could outplay him; JCH says he never felt that way and is happy when someone beats him.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Charlie didn't care; he just played.
What was Red's impression of Charlie Shavers?
Everybody. Red think nobody can outplay him.
Did you feel that way about the trombones?
Never in my life. I never felt like that about no trombone player in my whole life. Anybody beat me playing, I'm happy. I laugh about it, get a kick out of it.
